messages:
Emma Chen: Quick sync — PartnerOps asked for a tiny Terraform starter kit + mini refarch we can hand to cloud partners for Marketplace/onboarding. Goal: a minimal, well-documented 'lite' refkit that shows Redwood Private deployed into a partner VPC (GCP first), with an opinionated TF module, sample values, and a short README. Who can own the module template + README? :wave:

Jorge Alvarez: +1. Keep it intentionally opinionated and small. My checklist: expose a couple of vars (project, region, machine_type), clear outputs (endpoint, svc_account), and a single entrypoint module like `redwood/private-lite`. No multi-module nesting for the starter. Also include a `examples/quickstart` that wires up VPC peering and a tiny firewall rule. :ok_hand:

Maya Patel: We should reuse bits from our refarch-network and refarch-iam modules but strip docs and advanced options. I can extract network + IAM snippets and make them example-only (not published as a dependency). Also add an `example.tfvars` demonstrating a minimal production-ish config and a separate `dev.tfvars` for a local dev/demo mode.

DevPartnerBot: Checklist created: https://go/internal/partner-refkit-checklist — items: module template, quickstart README, example tfvars, CI (fmt + init + validate), integration smoke test, partner review doc.

Samir Rao: Two implementation asks: 1) CI pipeline (GitHub Actions) that runs `terraform fmt && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate` on PRs. 2) A lightweight acceptance test: spin up resources in a short-lifetime sandbox project and hit the health endpoint. For GCP we can use a small n1-standard1 and teardown after test. I'll scaffold the repo + GH Actions.

Emma Chen: Awesome. Proposed owners: Jorge -> module template + examples, Maya -> example vars + README and partner-facing step-by-step (10-min quick deploy), Samir -> repo + CI + smoke tests. I'll handle partner coordination and marketplace docs (legal + listing metadata). Target: internal preview by EOW, partner preview next Tue. :spiral_calendar:

Jorge Alvarez: I'll post a tiny module skeleton in #eng-runtime in ~2 hours. Example snippet I'll share in the repo:```
module "redwood_private_lite" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//terraform/redwood_private_lite"
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
  machine_type = var.machine_type
}
```

Maya Patel: I'll add `example.tfvars` and a short `README.md` with commands: `terraform init && terraform apply -var-file=example.tfvars -auto-approve` and a note about service account scopes and KMS keys for prod. Will mock an on-prem variant in the README with a short section.

Samir Rao: Repo created: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits/mini-refkit — pushing initial GH Action and `terraform fmt` job now. Will add a disposable-project smoke test job called `smoke-slow` with `if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true` to run on main.

Emma Chen: Great momentum. One more: include a short LICENSE snippet for reuse by partners (Apache 2.0 ok?). PartnerOps wants permissive. I'll confirm with legal but assume Apache.

Maya Patel: Apache is fine from my side. I'll add a CONTRIBUTORS section that explains how partners can fork and submit PRs.

Jorge Alvarez: Tagging @Samir Rao and @Maya Patel in the PR when I post the template. :thumbsup: 

Emma Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll lock partner review slots Thurs 10am PT. If anyone needs to shift timelines ping me here. :calendar:
